headline: Alphabet Shares Face Steep Drop as AI Concerns Weigh on Search Revenue
summary: Despite a doubling of cloud revenue, Alphabet faces investor concern that artificial intelligence is negatively impacting its ability to monetize search queries.
why: Alphabet Inc. is the parent company of Google, dominating global digital advertising and search markets. Shifts in search monetization directly impact its primary revenue stream and growth valuation.

impacts.name: Alphabet Inc.
impacts.why: Investor concern over AI hurting search query monetization and growth prospects creates downward pressure on the stock.

why_moved: Investor sentiment deteriorated as market participants weighed the high costs and disruptive effects of artificial intelligence on traditional search advertising margins.
